sql_asli_1baris: SELECT mp.nama_balai, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_laporan, SUM( CASE WHEN mpt.tanggal_kirim_kabalai < (DATE_TRUNC('month', mp.tgl_start) + INTERVAL '1 month' + INTERVAL '14 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS laporan_tepat_waktu, ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN mpt.tanggal_kirim_kabalai < (DATE_TRUNC('month', mp.tgl_start) + INTERVAL '1 month' + INTERVAL '14 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )::DECIMAL / COUNT(*) * 100, 2 ) AS persentase_tepat_waktu FROM mv_penandaan mp JOIN mv_penandaan_timeline mpt ON mp.id = mpt.id_penandaan WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mpt.tanggal_kirim_kabalai) = 2025 GROUP BY mp.nama_balai ORDER BY mp.nama_balai;
sql_dipakai_1baris: SELECT mp.nama_balai, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_laporan, SUM( CASE WHEN mpt.tanggal_kirim_kabalai < (DATE_TRUNC('month', mp.tgl_start) + INTERVAL '1 month' + INTERVAL '14 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS laporan_tepat_waktu, ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN mpt.tanggal_kirim_kabalai < (DATE_TRUNC('month', mp.tgl_start) + INTERVAL '1 month' + INTERVAL '14 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )::DECIMAL / COUNT(*) * 100, 2 ) AS persentase_tepat_waktu FROM mv_penandaan mp JOIN mv_penandaan_timeline mpt ON mp.id = mpt.id_penandaan WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mpt.tanggal_kirim_kabalai) = 2025 GROUP BY mp.nama_balai ORDER BY mp.nama_balai;
